caveats: Event onset 2021-06-01 equals the first target day, so it is left-truncated by the target window (per spec, no data outside it used); the event may have begun earlier. Threshold/climatology use 1992-2002 with the 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 margins. Only the 3309 cells finite on all target days are sea cells; land/partly-missing cells are 0 in the mask. Summer 2021 is ~3 K above the baseline mean, so most sea cells are hot on most days (about 58% of cell-days), which is a genuine anomaly but makes the event very large.
